vision.name: Orange Adept Mastery
vision.text:
[Continuous]: Your attacks deal +1 stage. After your MP advances a level, search your discard pile for a Drill and Rejuvenate it.
[Instant] POWER: Use after performing a successful Styled attack. That attack gains "HIT: If you control 2 or less Drills, search your Life Deck for a Styled [Continuous] Drill and place it into play."
vision.note: portrait FanZ Mastery layout; title and number confirmed from a crop of the original
